title: WaterWiseKids Swim Access Atlas — Coverage Diagnostic Pilot
public_label: Data coverage diagnostic — not an access score or swim-desert ranking
methodology_note: The pilot joins Census youth population with locations currently present in the WaterWiseKids school directory and starting pool list. Those WWK lists are not complete inventories, so the counts measure WWK data coverage, not all real-world access.
ownership_disclosure: WaterWiseKids and British Swim School businesses serving the Jersey Shore and Northwest Philadelphia share common ownership. That relationship is especially material in this pilot because several observed listings are affiliated schools.
